title: Chapter 1 — AI practice mock 3
instructions: Short original AI-authored practice, inspired by the teacher-topic questions; not an official or full-length mock. Self-mark using the guidance.

questions.text: A 100 × 80 image uses 8 bits per pixel. Calculate its uncompressed size in bits, ignoring metadata.

answer.text: The number of bits used to represent each pixel.

questions.explanation: Increasing depth allows more possible colours.

questions.text: Explain one effect of increasing image resolution.

answer.text: More pixels can represent finer detail, but uncompressed file size increases.

questions.explanation: Resolution and colour depth both affect size.
